## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior or clarified requirement.
State what is implemented and what remains a proposal.

## Contract effects

Identify schema/version, compatibility, extension, fixture and ADR changes, or
state why none are needed. Contract changes require maintainer agreement before
changing the frozen baseline.

## Validation

List the local checks run and their actual results, including `pnpm check`.
Explain omitted checks and remaining limitations. A schema pass is not evidence
of a working runtime, consent, rights or archive round-trip safety.

## Content and execution

Confirm new examples are original and synthetic, with applicable provenance and
licenses, and that no secrets or personal histories are included. Identify any
separately approved changes to execution policy; bootstrap does not authorize
Actions, remote publishing or deployments.
